project.name: From question to discovery
project.description: A sample research plan. Replace these steps with your own project.

tasks.title: Define the research question
tasks.goal: State the question, the comparison, and what evidence would answer it.
tasks.notes: Keep the first version small enough to finish. This is fictional example data.

tasks.title: Map the literature
tasks.goal: Summarize supporting evidence, competing explanations, and knowledge gaps.
tasks.notes: Record sources and uncertainty, not just conclusions.

tasks.title: Audit data & quality
tasks.goal: Check sample metadata, missingness, technical quality, and potential confounders.
tasks.notes: Separate biological replicates from technical replicates before analysis.

tasks.title: Finalize the analysis plan
tasks.goal: Specify comparisons, controls, sensitivity checks, and expected outputs.
tasks.notes: Define success before running the primary analysis.

tasks.title: Run the primary analysis
tasks.goal: Implement the agreed analysis in a reproducible script or notebook.
tasks.notes: Record environment, parameters, and input versions.
tasks.agent_instructions: Implement only the agreed analysis. Save code and a short execution report. Ask before changing the statistical design.

tasks.title: Validate & stress-test
tasks.goal: Check alternative assumptions and confirm that results are not driven by one sample or batch.
tasks.notes: A completed task is not automatically a verified scientific conclusion.

tasks.title: Build the figure story
tasks.goal: Create figures with a clear question, result, and limitation for each panel.
tasks.notes: Keep a record of how each figure was generated.

tasks.title: Synthesize & write
tasks.goal: Connect the results to the question and document unresolved limitations.
